basics.name: Benjamin Roget
basics.label: Engineering Student — Java Backend & Systems
basics.summary: Seeking a 3-month software engineering internship starting June 2027, in an English-speaking team. Engineering apprentice at IMT Nord Europe and Numih France. Java/Spring Boot backend and automated testing, with personal projects in Rust and Linux infrastructure.

work.name: Numih France
highlights: Refactored an existing Selenium/Java framework and migrated it to Spring Boot, sharing the test engine between Maven/Jenkins CI and an asynchronous REST API.
Built the Angular interface end to end for test launches, scheduling and execution monitoring, integrating WebSocket status notifications.
Made roughly 50–70 tests more reliable through test-data lifecycle management; reduced environment/version adaptation from about 4 hours to under 10 minutes (work-experience estimate).
Developed a separate Spring Boot tool distributing daily product-support duties across about 40 developers; maintained Java and Angular business features.
Conducted technical recruitment assessments (Java exercises and interviews); trained an intern and an apprentice on the testing framework.

work.name: Ekeep-IT
highlights: Developed REST APIs with Java and Spring Boot for My-UUU, an equestrian-facility directory and review platform.
Built responsive Next.js interfaces and delivered features in an Agile/Scrum team.

education.studyType: DUT Informatique (University Diploma of Technology in Computer Science)
education.score: Ranked first in the cohort in each year.
